note: Deterministic coaching sentences. Placeholders {name} are filled with engine facts only.

terms.reason.halfmove: 100 plies without a capture or pawn action

templates.action.castle_kingside: {color} castles on the king side: king {king_from} to {king_to}, rook {rook_from} to {rook_to}.
templates.action.castle_queenside: {color} castles on the queen side: king {king_from} to {king_to}, rook {rook_from} to {rook_to}.
templates.action.platform_keep: {color} moves platform {platform}, carrying the {piece}, from dock {from_dock} to dock {to_dock}, keeping its orientation.
templates.action.platform_turn: {color} moves platform {platform}, carrying the {piece}, from dock {from_dock} to dock {to_dock} and turns it by 180 degrees.
templates.attempt.acceptable: Acceptable: {label} meets the objective in a lesser way.
templates.attempt.illegal: This input is not a legal action; nothing was played.
templates.attempt.incorrect: Not yet: {label} is legal but does not meet the objective.
templates.def.attack: Attack as computed by the rules engine's attack function on projected coordinates; a piece on another board at the same coordinate is not attacked by a zero-step move.
templates.def.hanging: A piece is counted when an enemy piece attacks its coordinate and no friendly piece does, under the engine's attack function. Pins and exchanges are not considered.
templates.def.king_zone: Squares next to the king are physical squares one coordinate step away, on any board; a square at the king's own coordinate on another board does not count. The count is an indicator, not a measured risk.
templates.def.material: Material uses the provisional piece values of the built-in evaluation (pawn 100, knight 300, bishop 300, rook 500, queen 900); they are not measured values for this variant.
templates.fact.attack_count: Physical squares attacked by {color}: {before} before, {after} after; by {opp}: {obefore} before, {oafter} after.
templates.fact.capture_ep: It captures {victim_color}'s pawn on {square} en passant; the capturing pawn lands on {to}.
templates.fact.check_given: This gives check to {opp}'s king on {king}.
templates.fact.checkmate: Checkmate: {opp}'s king on {king} is in check and {opp} has no legal action, piece or platform.
templates.fact.double_step_lost: Transport uses up the pawn's double step: the pawn on {square} counts as moved.
templates.fact.draw_rule: The game ends in a draw by rule: {reason}.
templates.fact.escape.block: {color} was in check from {checkers}; a piece now blocks the line of attack.
templates.fact.escape.capture_checker: {color} was in check from {checkers}; the checking piece is captured.
templates.fact.escape.king_moves: {color} was in check from {checkers}; the king steps out of the attack.
templates.fact.escape.platform_block: {color} was in check from {checkers}; the moved platform places a piece on the line of attack.
templates.fact.escape.platform_king: {color} was in check from {checkers}; the platform carries the king out of the attack.
templates.fact.platform_coords: The {piece} keeps its physical square {square_id}; its coordinate changes from {from_coord} to {to_coord} (now {square}).
templates.fact.platform_orientation: Platform {platform} changes orientation from {before} to {after} degrees.
templates.fact.stalemate: Stalemate: {opp} has no legal action and is not in check; the game is drawn.
templates.fact.twin_squares: Coordinate {coord} also exists as {twins}; this action uses the physical square {to} on board {board}.
templates.heur.hanging: Attacked and not defended after this action: {pieces}.
templates.heur.king_zone: King safety indicator: {after} squares next to {color}'s king on {king} are attacked by {opp} (before: {before}).
templates.hint.L1.capture: One of {opp}'s pieces on board {board} can be taken without your capturing piece being taken back at once.
templates.hint.L1.checkmate: Look at {opp}'s king on {king}: list every square it could reach, on every board, and look for a check it cannot escape.
templates.hint.L1.coordinate_levels: Coordinate {coord} exists on boards {boards}. Only one of those squares holds the target.
templates.hint.L1.defend: Your {piece} on {square} is attacked by {attackers} from board {boards}.
templates.hint.L1.escape_check: Your king is in check from {n} piece(s) on board {boards}. List every way out: king steps, captures, blocks and platform transport.
templates.hint.L1.fork: These pieces can be attacked by one of your pieces at the same time: {targets}.
templates.hint.L1.generic: Read the objective again and look at every board, including the platforms and their free docks.
templates.hint.L1.improve_decision: The analysis prefers an action that takes effect on board {board}.
templates.hint.L1.platform_check: Look at the lines towards {opp}'s king on {king}. A platform can carry a piece onto such a line, and turning a platform changes the coordinate of the piece it carries.
templates.hint.L1.platform_escape: Your king is in check from {n} piece(s) on board {boards}. A platform can carry a piece, or the king, to a free adjacent dock.
templates.hint.L2.castle: Use your king and rook together.
templates.hint.L2.generic: Think about which of your pieces or platforms can change the situation.
templates.hint.L3.castle_kingside: Castle on the king side: the king goes to {king_to}, the rook to {rook_to}.
templates.hint.L3.castle_queenside: Castle on the queen side: the king goes to {king_to}, the rook to {rook_to}.
templates.hint.L3.dock_keep: Move it to dock {dock}, keeping its orientation; the carried piece ends on {square}.
templates.hint.L3.dock_turn: Move it to dock {dock} and turn it by 180 degrees; the carried piece ends on {square}.
templates.hint.L3.generic: Consider every square or dock that this piece or platform can legally reach.
templates.hint.L4.continuation: Analysed continuation, replayed through the rules engine (a bounded search at depth {depth}, not a forced line): {line}.
templates.hint.L4.more: This exercise accepts {n} solved and {m} acceptable actions.
templates.illegal.castle_unavailable: Castling is not available here (rights, empty squares, safety or platform position).
templates.illegal.continuation: Continuation action {n} ('{input}') is not legal after the previous actions; only the first action was graded.
templates.illegal.dock_not_adjacent: Dock {dock} is not adjacent to dock {from_dock}, where platform {platform} stands.
templates.illegal.dock_occupied: Dock {dock} is occupied by another platform.
templates.illegal.game_over: The game is already over; no action is legal.
templates.illegal.malformed: '{input}' is not a valid action identifier.
templates.illegal.no_promotion: This pawn does not reach a promotion square, so no promotion piece may be given.
templates.illegal.not_legal: '{input}' is not a legal action in this position.
templates.illegal.not_reachable: The {piece} on {from} cannot reach {to} under the rules.
templates.illegal.platform_occupancy: Platform {platform} can move only with exactly one piece on it; it has {n}.
templates.illegal.platform_wrong_side: Platform {platform} carries a piece of the other side; {side} cannot move it.
templates.illegal.promotion_required: A pawn arriving there must promote: add the promotion piece (=Q, =R, =B or =N).
templates.illegal.self_check: This action would leave your own king in check, so it is not legal.
templates.illegal.wrong_side: The piece on {square} belongs to {owner}, but it is {side}'s turn.
templates.item.budget_ordering: network-ordered search with {nodes} nodes, depth at most {depth}, per position
templates.limit.candidates: Each decision compares the played action with the {k} best actions of a one-ply static ranking; other actions were not searched.
templates.limit.model: Values come from a model evaluator; they are model estimates, valid only for the recorded model revision. Re-run the review if the model changes.
templates.limit.model_mcts: Model limit per position: {simulations} MCTS simulations (mode mcts). Actions are compared by their MCTS Q values; the most visited action is the model's choice, and rarely visited actions have uncertain values or none.
templates.limit.model_ordering: Model limit per position: alpha-beta search with {nodes} nodes, depth at most {depth}, with root actions ordered by the network (mode ordering); only completed depths are reported. Action values are heuristic units, not centipawns.
templates.limit.model_policy: Model limit per position: one network evaluation (mode policy), no search. Actions are compared by their policy probabilities, which are the network's preferences, not values.
templates.limit.model_units: Model values are p(win) - p(loss) for the side to act, between -1 and 1; policy probabilities lie between 0 and 1. Neither is a centipawn value, an accuracy figure or a rating.
templates.limit.search: Search limit per position: {nodes} nodes, depth at most {depth}; only completed depths are reported.
templates.limit.units: Values are heuristic units from the side to act's perspective. They are not centipawns, accuracy figures or ratings.
templates.objective.capture: {side} to act: capture a piece so that no reply can capture your capturing piece.
templates.objective.checkmate: {side} to act: deliver checkmate with one action.
templates.objective.coordinate_levels: {side} to act: capture {opp}'s {piece} standing at coordinate {coord}. Several boards have a square at this coordinate.
templates.objective.defend: {side} to act: your {piece} on {square} is threatened. Find an action after which it cannot be captured with a net gain.
templates.objective.escape_check: {side} to act is in check: find a way out after which the opponent has no checkmate in one.
templates.objective.fork: {side} to act: find an action after which one of your pieces attacks at least two of {opp}'s non-pawn pieces and cannot be captured at once.
templates.objective.improve_decision: {side} to act. In the game, {played} was played here. Find an action the analysis rates within {tolerance} heuristic units of its best analysed alternative.
templates.objective.platform_check: {side} to act: give check to {opp}'s king by moving a platform.
templates.objective.platform_escape: {side} to act is in check: escape by moving a platform, without allowing checkmate in one.
templates.plan.early_review: Early review to fill today's limit (box {box}, due {due}).
templates.plan.mastered_mix: Mixes in a theme solved repeatedly: {theme}.
templates.plan.personalisation_off: Practice personalisation is off: catalogue order ({theme}).
templates.reason.check_not_mate: It gives check, but the opponent still has {n} legal action(s).
templates.reason.checkmate: The opponent is in check and has no legal action.
templates.reason.escape_safe: The king is out of check and no reply checkmates.
templates.reason.favourable_trade: It captures a more valuable piece, but the reply {reply} can capture the capturing piece.
templates.reason.fork: The moved piece attacks at least two non-pawn pieces and cannot be captured at once.
templates.reason.keeps_piece: Afterwards the threatened piece cannot be captured with a net gain.
templates.reason.lesser_capture: It is a safe capture, but a more valuable piece could be taken safely.
templates.reason.lower_rated: Another accepted action is rated higher by the recorded search (depth {depth}).
templates.reason.mate_reply: After it, the reply {reply} is checkmate.
templates.reason.no_mate: It is not checkmate: the opponent has {n} legal action(s).
templates.reason.no_platform: It meets the goal, but without moving a platform.
templates.reason.not_fork: After it, the moved piece attacks {n} of the opponent's non-pawn pieces under the fork definition; at least two are needed.
templates.reason.not_target: It does not capture the target piece.
templates.reason.piece_lost: After it, the reply {reply} captures the threatened piece with a net gain.
templates.reason.platform_escape: The platform takes you out of check and no reply checkmates.
templates.reason.played_move: This is the action played in the game, which the analysis rated lower.
templates.reason.recapture: After it, the reply {reply} captures the capturing piece.
templates.reason.safe_capture: It captures, and no legal reply can capture the capturing piece.
templates.reason.searched: The analysis rates it within the tolerance of the best analysed alternative.
templates.reason.searched_lower: The search, with the exercise's budget, rates it clearly below the best analysed alternative.
templates.reason.searched_similar: The search, with the exercise's budget, rates it close to the best analysed alternative.
templates.reason.twin_square: {to} has the same coordinate {coord} as {target}, but it is a different physical square; the target stands on board {board}.
templates.reason.unsafe_fork: It is a fork, but the reply {reply} captures the forking piece.
templates.review.allows_mate_in_one: After the played action, {opp} has the checkmating reply {reply} (a rules fact).
templates.review.best_line: Analysed line for the best alternative, replayed through the rules engine: {line} (depth {depth}).
templates.review.compare: Best analysed alternative for {side}: {best} ({best_score}). Played: {played} ({played_score}). Compared among {n} candidates at depth {depth} with {nodes} nodes ({completeness}).
templates.review.compare_model: Best analysed alternative for {side}: {best} ({best_score}). Played: {played} ({played_score}). Compared among {n} candidates by the model ({cost}).
templates.review.evaluator_model: Evaluator: model {model} (revision {revision}). Its values are model estimates for this revision only.
templates.review.forced: This was the only legal action.
templates.review.gap: In this analysis the played action is {gap} heuristic units worse for {side} than the best analysed alternative at depth {depth}.
templates.review.gap_model: In this analysis the played action scores {gap} lower for {side} than the best analysed alternative ({kind}, model estimate).
templates.review.mate_against_line: After the played action, {opp} reaches checkmate within {plies} plies in the analysed line; this was not proven against every reply.
templates.review.mate_against_proven: After the played action, {opp} forces checkmate within {plies} plies: every reply was checked exhaustively ({replies} replies to the first action).
templates.review.mate_in_one: {action} would have been checkmate at once (a rules fact).
templates.review.mate_line: {action} leads to checkmate within {plies} plies in the analysed line; this was not proven against every reply.
templates.review.mate_proven: {action} forces checkmate within {plies} plies: all {replies} replies were checked exhaustively.
templates.review.material_line: In this analysed line, {side}'s material balance changes by {delta}. This is not proof that every reply loses material.
templates.review.not_critical: Among {n} analysed candidates the played action was rated within the threshold of the best (depth {depth}, {nodes} nodes, {completeness}).
templates.review.not_critical_model: Among {n} analysed candidates the model rated the played action within the threshold of the best ({cost}).
templates.review.reply_line: After {played}, the analysed reply line, replayed through the rules engine, is: {line} (depth {depth}).
templates.review.summary: {n} decisions reviewed with up to {nodes} nodes each; {k} were critical under this budget.
templates.review.summary_model: {n} decisions reviewed by the model ({cost}); {k} were critical under this budget.
templates.score.mate_for: checkmate within {plies} plies for the side to act
